about_short_description.short_description: Fast, scalable life-cycle assessments to help fashion brands lower their scope 3 emissions.

product.name: Carbonfact Carbon Accounting Software
product.description: Software that calculates and manages greenhouse gas emissions across Scope 1, 2, and 3 for apparel and footwear brands, providing detailed, activity-based carbon accounting and reporting.

product.name: Product Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) Engine
product.description: A platform that automates detailed life cycle assessments for apparel and footwear products, calculating environmental footprints at the SKU level using industry standards.

product.name: Compliance and Reporting Automation
product.description: A service that automates sustainability reporting for apparel and footwear brands, generating audit-ready reports compliant with CSRD, CDP, and other regulatory frameworks.

product.name: Eco-Design and Decarbonization Planning Tools
product.description: Tools that integrate environmental data into product design and sourcing processes, enabling simulation of emissions impacts and decarbonization scenario modeling.

product.name: Automated Data Ingestion and Management
product.description: A system that consolidates, cleans, and enriches product and supply chain data from multiple sources, automating data import and filling gaps for accurate carbon accounting.

product.name: Carbonfact fashion LCA database
product.description: A free database of 300+ fully disaggregated life cycle assessment datasets on fashion’s environmental impact.
